title: Thai Turkey Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired dish made with tender turkey and rich curry sauce. Serve with steamed rice or noodles for a delicious and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.notes: full-fat or low-fat, depending on preference

ingredients.name: curry paste
ingredients.notes: Thai red or green curry paste

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the turkey and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the turkey from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Add the mushrooms and bell peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Return the turkey to the skillet and cook until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.
